deck: DOCKET SELECTION, MDL MECHANICS, BELLWETHER POOLS & CASE ACQUISITION ECONOMICS
HITECH RECORD TRIAGE, CASE-MANAGEMENT STACKS, LITIGATION FINANCE & LAW-FIRM MSO STRUCTURES
site_ui.lead: Twelve chapters of practitioner testimony trace how mass-tort firms separate the injury from its payout vehicle, pick and underwrite dockets, acquire and convert claimants, front-load HITECH medical record retrieval, and fund the work through litigation finance, private equity, and law-firm MSO and ABS structures.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, each carrying timestamped inline attribution to its source video. Together they map the mass-tort pipeline from MDL consolidation, bellwether pools, and settlement matrices to record retrieval, case-management automation, and the capital structures now reaching into law firms.

MSO & ABS Structures: Healthcare Models, Fee Traps & Arizona's Experiment
flow: Treat the mass tort as the injury and pick the payout vehicle: class actions for small uniform harms, MDLs for serious injury claims where each plaintiff keeps an individual lawsuit
Pick the tort by lifecycle and power ranking, price every inventory against the Daubert outcome, and confirm leadership common-fund financing before committing to a docket
Run lead generation and intake, mine single-family cases for the next docket, and screen each claimant's individual injury profile before conversion
Front-load HITECH record retrieval and AI review so critical medical records and pharmacy proof are gathered before plaintiff fact sheets and defense authorizations
Run the inventory on Filevine, Litify and automation, calendaring every sworn plaintiff fact sheet deadline and auditing files for trial-readiness certification
Feed 50 to 100 claim bellwether pools into settlement matrices and administration, financed through litigation finance, portfolio funding, PE and law-firm MSO or ABS structures

tagline: Big Money. Small Teams. No Bullshit.
title: MASS-TORT CASE ACQUISITION, HITECH RECORD TRIAGE & LAW-FIRM MSOS
subtitle: Pick the tort by timing, sign only records-backed claimants, price every source on cost per retained case, demand digital charts at the $6.50 HITECH cap, and wrap the firm in a fixed-fee or cost-plus MSO that keeps case selection and settlement with lawyers
